description: This file defines a feature for retrieving profile details in an ASP.NET Core application using MediatR. It includes a query object, a validator for the query, and a handler that reads profile data.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A request object representing a query to retrieve profile details by username.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile details request by reading the profile using the provided profileReader.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to retrieve the profile, calling profileReader.ReadProfile and returning its result.
